neighbours.label: the determiner ' those' pointing back to something just mentioned (e.g. 'a return on those assets')
fire: The company bought new trucks last year, and the cost of fuel for those trucks has doubled.
She planted tulips in October, and by April most of those bulbs had flowered.
We made a list of small goals, and we stayed committed to those goals all year.
The museum received old letters from the family, and historians are now studying those letters.
He kept every receipt, because the tax office later asked about those payments.
Our town built three new schools, but the teachers in those schools are still underpaid.
The farmers sprayed the fields, and the chemicals from those sprays reached the river.
I remember the summers at the lake; the long evenings of those years were the happiest.

notes: Card: ' those' is 15 of top 32 peaks, mostly after a preposition; also ' if' in 'even if/especially if'. The + pole's output suppresses ' those/these', so this pole promotes them.
